messages:
annie-peopleops: Hi team — quick coordination for new hire Lina (contractor) starting Mon. She flies in Sat evening and can't make normal I-9 kiosk hours. Options: 1) weekend courier collects ID + delivers laptop, 2) schedule Mon 8:30 expedited check-in at HQ. We also have a delayed background check (vendor needs extra ID). Thoughts?

mike-it: Weekend courier is doable but need sign-off from security + courier vendor. Which office?

annie-peopleops: SF office (Pier 70). @emma-office-coordinator can you confirm courier access to dock? Security needs name + DOB + government ID type.

emma-office-coordinator: I can arrange weekend access but require 24h notice + driver's license copy for the courier manifest. Dock slot available Sat 10am-2pm. Courier must wear visitor badge. Also need laptop provisioning ticket number.

mike-it: I'll queue a laptop build with `BUILD-REQ-4127` and mark as high priority. ETA image + laptop = Sat noon if someone can meet courier. Who will meet?

lina-olson: I can meet at the dock Saturday noon — arriving 11:45. Happy to drop my passport copy to the courier for the manifest. Is that secure?

annie-peopleops: Thanks Lina. Courier will be AVIS secure courier (contractor). We'll redact after photo copy stored in ADP PII inbox per policy. @sanjeev-peopleops will coordinate the manifest handling.

sanjeev-peopleops: I'll submit the security waiver and approve weekend access. Lina please DM me your DOB & last 4 SSN for the courier manifest (we'll not store SSN beyond manifest).

bg-checks-bot: Background check vendor update — Candidate Lina Olson: STATUS = PENDING; ACTION REQUIRED: vendor requested an additional ID for overseas residency verification. Please upload copy to secure portal: https://redwood-secure-bg.example/verify/ABC123

lina-olson: Uploaded passport + proof of address to the portal just now.

bg-checks-bot: Received. Estimated completion 24-48 hours. Note: conditional start allowed with I-9 completed and signed acknowledgment of pending background check.

annie-peopleops: Good. Two action items: 1) security waiver + courier manifest (Sanjeev), 2) laptop build & provisioning ticket (Mike). Also we'll prepare Day-1 remote checklist + benefits packet. Lina, preference for orientation time Monday? 9am or 1pm?

lina-olson: 9am works best. Will be onsite early.

emma-office-coordinator: Booked conference room `Harbor-3` for 9-11am. Catering: coffee + light breakfast. I'll add a visitor badge for the courier and a temporary parking pass.

mike-it: Laptop build `BUILD-REQ-4127` assigned to @alex-it. Alex will meet courier Sat 12pm at dock.

alex-it: Confirmed. I'll be there. Bringing power adapter and charger. I'll hand off to Lina and run initial provisioning.

sanjeev-peopleops: Security waiver submitted. Courier manifest sent to Emma. Please ensure courier shows ID at desk.

annie-peopleops: Perfect — final checklist: courier scheduled Sat 12pm; Lina meets dock; I-9 form to be completed during handoff (we'll use paper I-9, Section 2 by authorized verifier Alex); BG still pending but vendor confirmed conditional start ok; Day-1 orientation 9am Harbor-3. Anything else?

lina-olson: Thanks everyone! One question: benefits enrollment window — when will I get the invite?

annie-peopleops: You'll get ADP invite within 24 hours of payroll activation (usually within first 48 hours). Enrollment window is 30 days from activation. We'll send a reminder on Day 3.

mike-it: FYI added `lina@redwood.example` to Google Workspace and Slack. Temporary credentials expire in 7 days; we will convert to full account after BG clears.

annie-peopleops: Closing loop — I'll post a final confirmation here after courier completes handoff. :thumbsup:

bg-checks-bot: Background check for Lina Olson: STATUS = IN PROCESS (received docs). Vendor ETA updated to 36 hours.
